question: The fundamental duties of citizens were added to the constitution of India by the 42nd amendment in:
solution:
The correct answer is **1976**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **Sardar Swaran Singh** Committee was established by the Congress Party in 1976 to offer suggestions regarding Fundamental Duties.
 
• During the internal situation, it became clear how important it is for the** Indian Constitution** to have Fundamental Duties (1975-1977).
 
• The committee suggested that the Constitution include a distinct chapter on **Fundamental Duties**.
 
• The federal Congress administration embraced these recommendations and in 1976 passed the **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act.**
 
• With this modification, the Constitution gained a new section called **Part IVA**, which contains Fundamental Duties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act,** 1976**, sometimes known as the 42nd Amendment, was passed by the Indian National Congress government led by Indira Gandhi between 25 June 1975 and 21 March 1977.
 
• While some of the **amendment's provisions** took effect on 1 February and **Section 27** on 1 April 1977, the majority of its provisions did so on 3 January 1977.
 
• The 42nd Amendment is thought to be the most divisive** constitutional change** in history.
